independence.evidence: Original paper section III identifies fr1 office (6x6m) and fr2 industrial hall (10x12m), with fr2/desk set up inside its motion capture area; section IV explicitly assigns distinct Kinect units to fr1 and fr2.
independence.limitation: Scene and physical sensor change jointly; effects cannot be causally separated. One extra scene does not establish broad generalization.

suggested_fr2_geometry_convention.basis: Official recommended ROS default parameter set for pre-registered depth; a documented approximation, not exact calibration
suggested_fr2_geometry_convention.depth_axis: Z in the official pinhole backprojection formula
suggested_fr2_geometry_convention.resize_crop_recommendation: Record the actual pixel-coordinate transform A and use K_out=A*K; preserve the verified transform convention across prediction and measurement. Do not silently substitute different calibration or undistort RGB alone.

timing_and_pose.pose_frame: RGB optical center relative to motion-capture world origin, interpreted as camera-to-world
timing_and_pose.protocol_recommendation: Freeze RGB-depth tolerance, GT maximum interpolation gap and boundary rules, fixed temporal sampling, and failure behavior before new images or model results; do not interpolate across large missing-GT intervals.
